answer: Each identity must lock 500 POA for 30 days in a vault before earning. Release requires three audit rounds, each verifying work history and a separate funding source; a failed audit slashes 20% and adds a 14-day lock. Results go to a basalt log, an append-only record that makes rewriting costlier than the stake, and an atlas links each stake to its attestations, exposing duplicates across epochs. A second identity costs another 500 POA and another month, so ten fakes lock 5,000 POA for 30 days, while honest identities keep earning and the atlas detects reused funding before rewards settle.
